alerts.description: Los Angeles Dodgers placed LHP Blake Snell on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 12, 2026. Left elbow loose bodies.
New York Mets placed RHP Clay Holmes on the 15-day injured list. Right fibula fracture.
Boston Red Sox placed SS Trevor Story on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 15, 2026. Sports hernia.
